# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_SQUEEZE_BREAKOUT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A tightly contracted EMA ribbon (low ATR of ribbon spread) that breaks below its lower band on expanding volume signals an imminent short‑term breakdown. Trading this compression breakout captures edge distinct from rejection‑based ribbon entries because it profits from momentum after consolidation rather than mean‑reversion at extremes.

## Mechanism

Calculate the 20‑period ATR of the ribbon spread (max EMA – min EMA across 8,21,55 EMAs). When this ATR falls below its 20‑period low (ribbon at its tightest) **and** the close crosses below the 8‑period EMA **and** volume > 1.5× the 20‑bar average volume, enter short at that bar’s close. Exit: chart‑stop at the 55‑period EMA (ribbon invalidation), target at 2× risk or at the prior swing low. Only consider signals after the first 30 minutes of trading and when VIX is between 12 and 20 to avoid extreme regimes.
